Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.

As a Site Coordinator / Operations Project Manager, this role acts as the central point of contact for all site-related projects. Responsibility includes the safe, efficient, and cost-effective planning and execution of projects at site ON1. The position requires excellent organizational skills to ensure that logistics projects are completed on time and meet the highest quality standards.

In Neuenburg am Rhein, two new logistics centers with more than 90,000 sqm of warehouse space are currently being built. For our Operations Center 1 (30,000 sqm), we are looking for a Site Coordinator / Operations Project Manager for operational logistics.

Deine Aufgaben

- Overall responsibility for small and medium-sized logistics projects, ensuring successful implementation
- During the concept phase, conducting detailed research, analysis, and cost calculations. Preparing decision-relevant information for the Site Lead and presenting it clearly and convincingly
- In the implementation phase, ensuring smooth coordination and collaboration between all involved and affected departments. Managing internal and external stakeholders, resource and timeline planning, as well as project controlling to guarantee target achievement and performance monitoring
- Actively contributing to solution development by combining analytical and technical expertise to create added value
- Supporting other project managers in additional projects and leading sub-projects outside of ON1 when required

Deine Fähigkeiten

- Strong analytical skills, supported by relevant education or further training in Project Management, Facility Management, or Supply Chain Management
- A technical background with initial experience as a project manager, ideally in logistics and/or infrastructure projects
- A solution-oriented and pragmatic mindset, combined with hands-on involvement to drive projects to success
- The ability to communicate openly and effectively with different stakeholders, bringing discussions and differing opinions to a shared consensus
- Very good written and spoken communication skills in German or French, as well as English
- Taking calculated risks to create value and drive growth
- Aligning actions and decisions with personal beliefs and values

Warum startest du bei uns?

- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach.
- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas.

Diversity is our culture.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.

You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:
* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.
* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage
* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role
* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

Your Application 

Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage. Please apply with English application documents. 

Please note that no additional documents can be submitted after your application has been sent.

We look forward to receiving your application and potentially welcoming you to our team!

 

 

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent ORM / Social Media Manager to start as soon as possible. As our new ORM / Social Media Manager , you will be the person who makes Contabo's shift from an affordable VPS provider to a reliable, AI ready, developer friendly infrastructure brand real, in the exact communities where developers, DevOps engineers, and AI practitioners actually talk. You build that credibility from the ground up, combining daily community intelligence with real commercial content production.

Every day, you monitor selected online platforms like Reddit or Discord, triaging brand mentions for further action. You also engage proactively wherever technical conversations happen, from tutorials and GPU workload guides to infrastructure tips and genuine participation in technical discussions, always credibility first and aligned with our tone of voice.

You report directly to our Head of Creative Marketing, and the monthly picture you build of sentiment, Share of Voice, and platform activity feeds straight into product and marketing decisions, with real visibility all the way up to our CMO. At its core, this role lives at the intersection of protecting our reputation and driving commercial content forward: someone who speaks the language of developers, but thinks like a marketer.

• Strong communication and conflict handling skills, clear goal and result orientation, and the ability to build and grow a network without formal authority
• A proactive, ownership driven mindset: you handle pressure well, stay customer oriented, and hold yourself to a high-performance bar
• An authentic community voice who shows up as a real person rather than a brand account, thinks commercially about when community presence drives business outcomes, and stays composed under public criticism without escalating situations

Should have:

Nice to have:

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as the Team Lead for Nuclear Controls Product Management (f/m/d), where you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our Nuclear Instrumentation & Control (I&C) product portfolio. You will lead the strategic direction, ensuring commercial success and regulatory compliance for critical infrastructure applications. Imagine driving product strategy and roadmap decisions while acting as the key interface between customers, engineering, quality, operations, sales, and regulatory stakeholders. Your leadership will guide the product lifecycle management process, ensuring that our offerings meet the highest standards of safety and quality throughout their lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute the global product strategy for the Nuclear Controls portfolio, securing an annual business volume of 100 million Euros
* Manage long-term product lifecycles, aligning with both new-build projects and multi-decade service commitments
* Drive product roadmap decisions, balancing standard product development with project-specific customization needs
* Oversee compliance with stringent international nuclear standards, licensing requirements, and safety-critical certification processes
* Navigate complex regulatory frameworks to ensure all product lines maintain necessary qualifications for global deployment
* Provide continuous strategic support and requirement engineering for key nuclear customers, fostering long-term partnerships

What You Bring

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive professional experience in Product Management or Engineering within the nuclear industry or other highly regulated, safety-critical environments, including responsibility for large-scale product portfolios
* Proven leadership and management experience in senior roles, with a track record of leading cross-functional teams in an international environment
* Professional certifications in Product and/or Project Management, such as Certified Product Manager (AIPMM) or Project Management Professional (PMP), considered an asset
* Expertise in Product Management and Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and the nuclear industry domain
* Strong strategic decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities, combined with business-fluent English and German language skills; French language skills are advantageous

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
